findings.issue: This is the exact key the glossary note cites: Ovate is frozen as أوفيت, "named NPC + title of address (ST_Core_NpcNames/Ovate, Ovate's Chamber); name, so transliterated". العَرّاف translates it as 'soothsayer', so the NPC loses their name in the nameplate and in Ovate's Chamber.

Mutton is the proper NAME of Vlas's companion animal — his dialogue says "Mutton and I will depart in the night". Rendered as خَروف it becomes the common noun 'a sheep', so the nameplate reads as a species label and the quest lines about him stop referring to anyone.

المُريد is frozen as Acolyte, which is Tiel's title. This is the canonical NPC-name row for the generic 'Disciple', so it is the source of the collision that also shows up in Disciple's Grotto, Discple's Stash and Franz's 'You're not a disciple' line.
Same Acolyte/disciple collision as ST_Core_NpcNames/Disciple; should move with it.

This NPC roster is a set of plant-themed PERSONAL names. Half of them are translated into the plant noun (Basil=ريحان، Birch=بتولا، Daisy=أُقحوان، Elm=دَردار، Fern=سَرخَس، Holly=بَهشِيّة، Lily=سَوسَن، Marigold=آذَريون، Nettle=قُرّاص، Spruce=شَرْبين) while Dahlia and Jasmine in the same list are transliterated as names (داليا، ياسمين). As it stands the nameplate for this character reads as a common noun, not a person, and the roster is internally inconsistent. Every other character name in the build is transliterated per the style guide. One direction has to be chosen for the whole set.
Part of the same plant-name set: بتولا is read as بتولا (the birch tree), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: أُقحوان is read as أُقحوان (the daisy flower), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: دَردار is read as دَردار (the elm tree), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: سَرخَس is read as سَرخَس (the fern plant), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: بَهشِيّة is read as بَهشِيّة (the holly shrub), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: سَوسَن is read as سَوسَن (the lily flower), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: آذَريون is read as آذَريون (the marigold flower), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: قُرّاص is read as قُرّاص (the nettle weed), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.
Part of the same plant-name set: شَرْبين is read as شَرْبين (the spruce tree), not as a person's name, while Dahlia/Jasmine in the same roster stay transliterated.

المُشعوذ is a charlatan/quack rather than a worker of illusions, and 'Hall of Illusions' / 'Illusionist's Cache' already use the الأوهام root. If Illusionist's Cache is corrected, this title should sweep with it. The name ڤرانيك is correct per the glossary.
